name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Hecherhof
beschreibung: The Hecherhof in Thiersee is a working farm offering holiday apartments. The accommodation is designed for self-catering guests and features a fully equipped kitchen. Lake Thiersee is within walking distance and invites you to swim during the summer months. In winter, guests can conveniently drive to nearby ski resorts such as Kössen. Farm animals live on the property, providing authentic insights into traditional alpine agriculture. The surroundings are quiet and enveloped by lush forests. Situated in the scenic Thierseetal valley, Thiersee serves as an ideal base for excursions into the Brandenberg Alps.
